extracted.name: Octoberfest German Potato Salad
extracted.description: This creamy German potato salad is a wonderful combination of sweet and sour flavors. Plus, it’s easy to double if you’re feeding a crowd!
instruction_lines: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, and transfer to a large bowl. Add onions.
Whisk mayonnaise, vinegar, oil, sugar, parsley, salt, and pepper together in a large bowl. Gently stir in the potatoes and onion. Let stand for 1 hour before serving to enhance flavors.
